recommendation_summary: Set up one external heartbeat monitor that `nightly-sync` pings after it finishes successfully, so you get an email if the ping hasn't arrived by a deadline; keep cron and the existing summary email as they are.

labels.Requirements and who asked: You want to know when `nightly-sync` fails without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: Central logging on the Synology and Docker migration add maintenance without solving the missing-alert problem.
labels.Bottleneck: The script sends its own email, so an early crash also disables its alert.
labels.Checked myself: Only your account: cron runs at 03:00 on `edna`, and four startup failures produced no email.

note: The reply recommends a single heartbeat alert, rejects the Synology log and Docker setup, and its 'Checked myself' line cites only facts from the situation without claiming any checks were run.
